Web, email and domains

Get your business properly set up online.

A website, professional email, your own domain and the support to keep it all working. One friendly, practical place to start.

Tell us what you need ↗See what we can help with ↓

Everything in one place

The essentials your business needs to be found, trusted and ready for work.

You do not need to know which platform, domain setting or email licence is right for you. Tell us where you are now and where you want the business to get to, and we will recommend a sensible route.

A website that represents your business properly

A fast, mobile-friendly website built around what you do and the customers you want to reach. We can help with the words, structure, contact options and the practical details that turn a visit into an enquiry.

Professional business email

Use an address on your own domain, with Microsoft 365 set up securely for you. Whether you are starting fresh or moving from an old inbox, we make the change straightforward.

Your own domain and reliable DNS

We help register, transfer and manage your domain, then connect it correctly to your website and email. The important accounts stay clearly owned by your business.

Google Business Profile setup

Make it easier for local customers to find you in Google Search and Maps, with the right business details, service areas, opening hours and website link in place.

Ongoing technical support

When details change, you are not left trying to work out hosting, email settings or DNS records alone. We remain your point of contact for the technical side.

Clear pricing, properly scoped

Web services starting from £10 per month.

Every business needs something a little different, so we scope website work around your goals, content and functionality rather than pushing you into a package that does not fit. You will receive a clear quote for the build before any work begins. Monthly web services, including hosting and the technical foundations, start from £10 per month.

How we get you online

Simple from first conversation to launch.

01

Start with your business, and where you want it to go

Tell us what you do, who you want to reach and what you already have. A rough idea is enough.

02

Get a clear recommendation

We outline the right next steps, explain the options plainly and provide a tailored quote for any website build.

03

Launch with the basics covered

We connect the website, email, domain and Google profile, then stay available when you need help afterwards.

Already have some of it?

We can work with the setup you have.

Perhaps you have a domain but no website, use a personal email address, or have a site that needs bringing up to date. We can pick up from there, including moving services from an existing provider where appropriate.
